entries.title: GPT-6.1 Terra joins your Codex models
entries.body: Models lists GPT-6.1 Terra for Codex accounts whose plan offers it. It starts in no level, so your crew uses it only once you place it. GPT-5.5 and GPT-5.3 Codex Spark leave the Codex list, because they always fail for ChatGPT sign-ins.
entries.noPicture: Terra's row comes from the live Codex catalog, which the offline picture launcher cannot reach, and the Models board itself looks the same.

entries.title: Starting levels for new models can change without an update
entries.body: Infinitary checks once a day for the levels new models should start in, so a newly released model can start in the right level without waiting for an Infinitary update. Levels you have already set stay as they are.
entries.noPicture: The change is where a newly seen model starts, which the Models board shows the same way as before.
